name: the one LOAD and its printings (COMPASS-REBOL-06, ruled yes 2026-10-30), fixtures first
comment: Written BEFORE any reader or printer. LOAD reads C6 text (strings in double quotes, numbers, lower_snake words, UPPER_SNAKE keywords, paths a.b, pairs key: value, lists [ ], groups ( ), comments --) into a block of typed values; the memo spelling (the indentation subset of C9 and .pia, read as _StzOutputParseMemo reads it) loads to the same values: a map is a group of pairs, a list a list, every scalar a string. "same" pairs must LOAD to equal blocks, "differ" pairs must not; "canonical" gives the one printing of a block; "refused" a text the LOAD refuses, with a fragment of why.

same.name: one declaration, one line and many lines
same.a: DEFINE MENU tones AS (WORDS [plain, formal], CODE "X") RATIONALE "the tones"
same.b:
DEFINE MENU tones AS (
  WORDS [
    plain,
    formal,
  ],
  CODE "X",
) RATIONALE "the tones"

same.name: a string across lines folds its continuation indent to one space (C6 3.2)
same.a:
DEFINE X y AS () RATIONALE "a long
    rationale"
same.b: DEFINE X y AS () RATIONALE "a long rationale"

same.name: CRLF and LF are the same text (C6 3.10)
same.a:
DEFINE MENU tones AS (
WORDS [plain, formal], CODE "X") RATIONALE "the tones"
same.b:
DEFINE MENU tones AS (
WORDS [plain, formal], CODE "X") RATIONALE "the tones"

same.name: a memo in its own spelling and in C6 are one block
same.a:
by: ringpp
subject: a memo
did:
  - one thing
  - another
state:
  ringpp: next 9a92a6f

same.name: a .pia agent (a list of maps) in both spellings
same.a:
pia: 1
name: stock-watcher
skills:
  - name: check-stock
    when: always

same.name: a comment survives as a value of the block, in its place

differ.name: two items are not one row of two values
a string is not a word
a keyword is not a word: case is meaning (C6 3.4, 3.5)
in the memo spelling every scalar is a string, so the C6 word is another value

canonical.name: a declaration: its clauses one a line, a list inline, no trailing comma
canonical.text:
DEFINE MENU tones AS (
  WORDS [
    plain,
    formal,
  ],
  CODE "X",
) RATIONALE "the tones"
canonical.canonical:
DEFINE MENU tones AS (
  WORDS [plain, formal],
  CODE "X"
) RATIONALE "the tones"

canonical.name: two declarations: a blank line between them
canonical.text: DEFINE MENU tones AS (WORDS [plain, formal], CODE "X") RATIONALE "the tones" DEFINE MENU moods AS (WORDS [plain, formal], CODE "X") RATIONALE "the moods"
canonical.canonical:
DEFINE MENU tones AS (
  WORDS [plain, formal],
  CODE "X"
) RATIONALE "the tones"

DEFINE MENU moods AS (
  WORDS [plain, formal],
  CODE "X"
) RATIONALE "the moods"

canonical.name: a memo printed in its own spelling
canonical.canonical:
by: ringpp
subject: a memo
did:
  - one thing
  - another
state:
  ringpp: next 9a92a6f

refused.name: single quotes are .zql's divergence (D-ZQL-1), not C6
a comma outside a list or a group
a memo that opens with a bare list (as _StzOutputParseMemo refuses it)
